name: Gensim
description: Classic text analysis with Gensim: word counts, TF-IDF similarity search and text reuse, and topic models (LDA, NMF, LSI, HDP, k-means).

bow.name: Bag of words
bow.description: Every word of the text with its count, most frequent first.

languages.name: Stop-word languages
languages.help: Common words of these languages are left out of topic names. None chosen: Finnish and English.

language_codes.name: Other languages
language_codes.help: More stop-word lists by ISO code, e.g. 'hu, cs'. 58 languages are available.

extra_stopwords.name: Extra stop words
extra_stopwords.help: Your own words to leave out, separated by commas (e.g. OCR noise).

similarity_index.name: Similarity index
similarity_index.description: TF-IDF index of this text. Open it and paste another text to find the passages they share.

window.name: Passage length (words)
window.help: The texts are compared in passages of this many words. Short passages find short quotes; long ones find paraphrases.

overlap.name: Overlap (words)
overlap.help: Words shared by consecutive passages, so that a match is not cut in two.

similarity_index_set.name: Similarity index
similarity_index_set.description: TF-IDF index of the texts of this set. Open it and paste a text to find which texts share passages with it; also searchable in the Search tab.

window.name: Passage length (words)
window.help: The texts are compared in passages of this many words. Short passages find short quotes; long ones find paraphrases.

overlap.name: Overlap (words)
overlap.help: Words shared by consecutive passages, so that a match is not cut in two.

search.name: Similarity search
search.description: Used by the index viewer and the Search tab: the passages of the index most like a query text.

threshold.name: Smallest similarity
threshold.help: Text reuse: passages less alike than this are not matches.

topics.name: Topics
topics.description: Topic model of the texts of this set with a method of your choice. Writes topics.json and a chart of each topic's words; run it again with another method to compare.

values.lda: LDA: documents as mixes of topics
values.nmf: NMF: matrix factorization, often cleaner on short or noisy texts
values.lsi: LSI: fast, topics as directions (words can weigh negatively)
values.hdp: HDP: chooses the number of topics itself
values.kmeans: k-means: each document in exactly one cluster

num_topics.name: Number of topics
num_topics.help: Topics (clusters for k-means) to find. HDP ignores this.

values.texts: Texts: each text is one document

passage_words.name: Passage length (words)
passage_words.help: With passages: words in each passage.

languages.name: Stop-word languages
languages.help: Common words of these languages are left out of topic names. None chosen: Finnish and English.

language_codes.name: Other languages
language_codes.help: More stop-word lists by ISO code, e.g. 'hu, cs'. 58 languages are available.

extra_stopwords.name: Extra stop words
extra_stopwords.help: Your own words to leave out, separated by commas (e.g. OCR noise).

min_docs.name: Rare words
min_docs.help: Leave out words that are in fewer than this many documents. Empty: 2 (1 for fewer than 10 documents).

max_share.name: Common words (%)
max_share.help: Leave out words that are in more than this share of the documents.

passes.name: Passes
passes.help: LDA, NMF and HDP: training rounds over the documents. More is slower but more stable.

seed.name: Random seed
seed.help: Same seed and settings give the same topics.

topics_text.name: Topics
topics_text.description: Topics within this text: the text is split into passages and they are modelled with a method of your choice.
